properties.label: Centred beam composition
properties.text: Place a concise centred promise across a near-black stage while one broad diagonal beam enters from the upper right and passes behind the copy.

properties.label: Blue-black cyan atmosphere
properties.text: Use blue-black #05070a, cool white type and a restrained cyan cast.

properties.label: Single volumetric beam
properties.text: Give one beam a defined edge, long soft falloff, irregular dust density and a plausible off-canvas source; the scene's event is the boundary between illuminated haze and darkness.

properties.label: Rim-lit translucent controls
properties.text: Use small translucent controls with a lit upper rim.

properties.label: Optional slow dust drift
properties.text: Keep the whole scene present in the still frame; optional dust drifts slowly while text and controls remain fixed, and reading never depends on an entrance sequence.

properties.label: Beam construction boundary
properties.text: Avoid multiple conic rays and centred radial blobs.

properties.label: Beam readability acceptance
properties.text: Keep the headline readable across the brightest beam region and recompose the beam origin at portrait widths.
